A fixed absolute permutation tolerance changed results with units; a variance floor manufactured finite standardized effects. Independent review then reproduced finite-input overflow at 1e308.

decisions.predicted_consequence: A constant paired difference has a constant interval even when the individual methods vary. Scaling units preserves the sampled sign-flip p-value; representable extreme means and intervals stay finite.
